Examples include: a civil engineer uses scientific knowledge to design bridges that withstand forces such as wind, earthquakes and heavy traffic; a software engineer applies scientific and mathematical knowledge to develop user-friendly applications; and an aviation engineer uses scientific knowledge to select lighter materials that can withstand the conditions experienced during flight.

Science is the organized body of knowledge about natural phenomena. Technology consists of methods and techniques developed using scientific knowledge; for example, automobile technology applies principles of thermodynamics. Engineering applies scientific knowledge and technology to design solutions for specific needs; for example, a civil engineer designs bridges to withstand heavy traffic and severe weather.
